info.title: SHRIII API
info.description:
SHRIII Kiosk Behavioural Games backend (ingestion, research and admin APIs).

Five data layers are kept separate: raw events (append-only) -> behavioural indicators -> criterion
scale scores -> validated trait estimates -> participant-facing interpretations (release-gated).
Authentication: OIDC JWT bearer tokens (dev: ``POST /api/v1/auth/dev-login``); kiosks use device
tokens (``kdt_...``). Every write and every research-data read is audited.

post.description: Accepts an ``UploadBatch`` (contracts upload-batch.v1). ``sha256`` must equal the SHA-256 of the RFC 8785 (JCS) serialisation of ``session_chunks``. Replays with the same ``batch_id`` return the stored result (``duplicate_batch=true``). Each event gets ``accepted | duplicate | parked | rejected_terminal | retryable``; scorable events wait in consent parking until core consent arrives; ``server_received_at`` is set by the server.

expected_response.description: Administration-file key, stored for rescoring: the instructed response of an attention-check item, or the minimum number of moves for a performance '<problem>.moves' measure (required there)

device_token.title: Device Token
device_token.description: Shown once; store it in the kiosk's secure storage

backend_x25519_public_key.title: Backend X25519 Public Key
backend_x25519_public_key.description: Base64; seal per-session DEKs to this key

algorithm.title: Algorithm
algorithm.description: gradient_boosting is an alias of xgboost

holdout_cohort.title: Holdout Cohort
holdout_cohort.description: Cohort kept untouched for final confirmation

reliability.title: Reliability
reliability.description: Retest reliability used for the SEM (from a validation run)

external_ref.title: External Ref
external_ref.description: Legacy identifier to reconcile; the pid is HMAC-derived and the reference is never stored.

cell.title: Cell
cell.description: language, age_band, gender, edu_band, literacy_band ('*' = any)

analysis.title: Analysis
analysis.description: One of descriptives, reliability, construct_validity, mtmm, factor_structure, measurement_invariance, dif, fairness, incremental_validity

requires_prereg.title: Requires Prereg
requires_prereg.description: Defaults to true for S2 onwards

scores.title: Scores
scores.description: Present only for callers allowed to read scores (never field administrators)

password_change_required.title: Password Change Required
password_change_required.description: The account still uses an operator-issued initial password; prompt a change

UploadBatchResult.title: UploadBatchResult
UploadBatchResult.description: Server response to an UploadBatch with a per-event status.

AsrResultPayload.description: Closed-vocabulary ASR proposal. No alternatives in production.
AsrResultPayload.title: AsrResultPayload

BandsAnsweredPayload.description: Picture-band answers. Under-18 selections are never logged.
BandsAnsweredPayload.title: BandsAnsweredPayload

CalibrationResultPayload.description: Calibration level locked for the session.
CalibrationResultPayload.title: CalibrationResultPayload

ConsentDeclinedPayload.description: Consent declined. Only an anonymous counter is retained for declined core consent.
ConsentDeclinedPayload.title: ConsentDeclinedPayload

ConsentGrantedPayload.description: Consent committed by tap only (never by voice).
ConsentGrantedPayload.title: ConsentGrantedPayload

ContextShiftPayload.description: A controlled condition change. The only valid source of switch points for scoring.
ContextShiftPayload.title: ContextShiftPayload

EnvNoiseDbfsPayload.description: Noise floor inside a consented prompt window.
EnvNoiseDbfsPayload.title: EnvNoiseDbfsPayload

EventCondition.description: Experimental condition; null for session-level events.
EventCondition.title: EventCondition

EventServerFields.description: Populated by the backend at ingestion. Kiosks always send nulls.
EventServerFields.title: EventServerFields

EventSessionContext.description: Session context carried on every event. participant_pid is null until consent and linkage.
EventSessionContext.title: EventSessionContext

EventTaskPosition.description: Task position; null for session-level events.
EventTaskPosition.title: EventTaskPosition

InputRawTapPayload.description: Every raw tap, never debounced (extra and premature taps included).
InputRawTapPayload.title: InputRawTapPayload

InvalidPayload.description: Placeholder written with the same seq when an event fails validation; keeps seq gapless.
InvalidPayload.title: InvalidPayload

LanguageSelectedPayload.description: Language chosen by tapping a speaking face.
LanguageSelectedPayload.title: LanguageSelectedPayload

LanguageSwitchedPayload.description: Language switch via the globe icon.
LanguageSwitchedPayload.title: LanguageSwitchedPayload

ModuleEndPayload.description: A game module or episode ends.
ModuleEndPayload.title: ModuleEndPayload

ModuleStartPayload.description: A game module or episode starts.
ModuleStartPayload.title: ModuleStartPayload

OptinContactPayload.description: Contact opt-in. Boolean only; contact details never enter event tables.
OptinContactPayload.title: OptinContactPayload

PlainSessionChunk.description: Development/browser-build chunk without envelope encryption. Rejected by production ingestion policy.
PlainSessionChunk.title: PlainSessionChunk

PracticeSummaryPayload.description: Practice + warm-up outcome and motor covariates (not scorable).
PracticeSummaryPayload.title: PracticeSummaryPayload

PromptAudioEndPayload.description: End of a spoken prompt (latency anchor audio_end).
PromptAudioEndPayload.title: PromptAudioEndPayload

PromptWindowOpenPayload.description: A response window opens (the microphone may open only inside a consented window).
PromptWindowOpenPayload.title: PromptWindowOpenPayload

ReportPayload.description: Private report. Only the reported value is logged; the true outcome is never logged (dice mode a).
ReportPayload.title: ReportPayload

ResearcherAnnotationPayload.description: Think-aloud observer code (closed codebook; no free text).
ResearcherAnnotationPayload.title: ResearcherAnnotationPayload

ResponsePayload.description: Committed response (closed code). Latency is signed; null only on timeout.
ResponsePayload.title: ResponsePayload

SessionAbandonedPayload.description: Session abandoned; consented events are kept, there is no resume.
SessionAbandonedPayload.title: SessionAbandonedPayload

SessionContext.description: Per-session covariate and configuration record (plan section 6.2). Emitted in the session.context event and stored with the session.
SessionContext.title: SessionContext

SessionContextNoise.description: Noise statistics measured inside the first consented prompt window only.
SessionContextNoise.title: SessionContextNoise

SessionContextPayload.description: Session covariates (SessionContext). May be re-emitted when bands or calibration change.
SessionContextPayload.title: SessionContextPayload

SessionStartPayload.description: First event of every session. Records the session seed and arm assignment.
SessionStartPayload.title: SessionStartPayload

SessionTombstonePayload.description: Tombstone covering uploaded and not-yet-uploaded events of this session.
SessionTombstonePayload.title: SessionTombstonePayload

StimulusOnsetPayload.description: Stimulus presentation timing (ENG-01). Times are on the session monotonic clock.
StimulusOnsetPayload.title: StimulusOnsetPayload

TrialStartPayload.description: A trial begins (stimulus not yet presented).
TrialStartPayload.title: TrialStartPayload

WalkawayResumedPayload.description: Player resumed after a walkaway prompt.
WalkawayResumedPayload.title: WalkawayResumedPayload

UploadBatch.description: Idempotent kiosk upload batch (plan section 6.2, KSK-07, ING-02). Session-ordered; <= 500 events or 256 kB.
UploadBatch.title: UploadBatch
